processSteps.title: Get in touch
processSteps.description: WhatsApp, email, or the form — whichever suits you. The first 30-minute consultation is free, with no long sales pitch.

processSteps.title: Scope & quote
processSteps.description: We write a concrete proposal: what gets built, how long it takes, and what it costs — final numbers, not rough guesses.

processSteps.title: Kick-off
processSteps.description: Once you approve, development starts right away against a delivery date we agreed on together.

processSteps.title: Development + check-ins
processSteps.description: We work in two-week sprints and send you progress updates weekly. Scope changes get discussed before we build, not after.

processSteps.title: QA & testing
processSteps.description: Before launch we test functionality, security, and the mobile experience. You give the final green light to go live.

processSteps.title: Launch & support
processSteps.description: Deploy to production, train your team, 30 days of free bug fixes, then a support package if you need one.

advantages.title: Transparent pricing
advantages.description: The cost is agreed up front and written into the proposal — no hidden fees and no surprise billing halfway through.

advantages.title: A timeline you can plan around
advantages.description: Start and finish dates are set before kick-off, so you can plan your launch with confidence instead of waiting on vague promises.

advantages.title: Direct access to the builders
advantages.description: You work with the people writing the code. Dozer, our founder, is hands-on for the projects that matter — no account-manager layer.

advantages.title: A modern tech stack
advantages.description: React, Next.js, PostgreSQL — the same stack behind our first-party products. Built for SaaS-scale products, not throwaway demos.

advantages.title: Support after launch
advantages.description: We don't disappear once the last invoice clears. Maintenance packages keep the support going.

advantages.title: Local, and we get the context
advantages.description: Based in Indonesia — same timezone, same language, and a real understanding of why your processes work the way they do.

faq.question: What does development cost?
faq.answer: It depends on scope. A landing page or a simple feature can start around Rp 25 million; a fuller MVP usually lands between Rp 50–150 million. We go through the details in a free consultation — no pressure.

faq.question: How long does it take?
faq.answer: A typical MVP runs 3–6 months depending on complexity. The firm timeline is in the proposal before kick-off.

faq.question: When can you start?
faq.answer: Usually within 2–4 weeks of signing the agreement.

faq.question: What quality guarantees do I get?
faq.answer: Strict code review, thorough testing, and 30 days of free bug fixes after launch.

faq.question: Who will actually work on my project?
faq.answer: The DN Tech team, with Dozer (our founder) involved in the critical work — never handed off to juniors without supervision.

faq.question: What if I need changes after launch?
faq.answer: You get 30 days of free bug fixes. After that: a monthly maintenance package, or hire anyone you like — the code is yours.

faq.question: My startup doesn't have a big budget yet — can we still work together?
faq.answer: Yes. We offer hourly consulting, revenue share on the right projects, or a flexible arrangement that fits your situation.

faq.question: Can we have a free consultation first?
faq.answer: Of course. Thirty minutes, free, to talk through what you need. No pressure — you decide afterwards.
